capabilities: Capture short memos with tags, wikilinks, images, mood, and source
Browse memos as a card waterfall with heatmap and tag/date/keyword filters
Export memos as PNG card images or to Obsidian Canvas
Import Flomo HTML exports with timestamps and tags
extras: Makes no network requests; all data stays local. Installable via BRAT for beta testing. Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: Flomo-style quick capture and card view for Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in fast capture flow with a card-based browsing view for short, tagged thoughts.

relations.evidence: One-click Flomo HTML import with timestamps and tags
All memos have type: memo in frontmatter, making them easy to query with Dataview.

summary: Flomo-style quick capture and card view that stores each memo as a standalone Markdown file with tags, mood, and source metadata.
